notes.title: General Update Before Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110336/26cad71c01f5e20d9d62cc9d9949fbf7090c120d.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Son of Prophecy! The excitement is building, and we’re just as eager as you are to launch Aeons Echo on Steam!

As we prepare for the big day, we want to remind you that the Steam version is launching as a completely separate experience. This means you’ll be diving into a fresh adventure, filled with new rewards and even more thrilling encounters with your favorite characters. Cross-platform syncing will not possible due to platform compliance.

There’s a lot to look forward to on this new platform, and we’re sure you’ll love the experience!

Don't forget to wishlist Aeons Echo on Steam to start your journey with some awesome freebies!


The Aeons Echo Team
